verdict.rationale: `tofu plan` previews the changes OpenTofu would make to bring infrastructure in line with configuration. Its refresh-only mode explicitly creates a plan that reconciles state with changes made to remote objects outside OpenTofu, which is the core of detecting drift between declared config and real cloud resources. Saved plan files (`-out`) let teams review those differences before acting. Missing for 10: docs that frame this explicitly as drift detection, a documented machine-readable or exit-code signal for automated or scheduled drift checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
